after:
full:
    # The full gate's bulk, sharded (APRV-149). Three jobs run a third of the
    # suite each, so the tier's wall clock is the slowest shard rather than one
    # `node --test` pool on two runner cores. The assignment lives in
    # scripts/run-tests.mjs: the file at sorted position i belongs to shard
    # (i mod 3) + 1, so every discovered file is in exactly one shard and the
    # matrix covers all of them. The runner refuses an out-of-range index or an
    # empty shard rather than exiting green over a slice nothing ran.
    #
    # One compile per job. The build step compiles and the runner runs what it
    # built; `npm test` would compile a second time and `npm run typecheck` a
    # third, and neither pass can fail where the build passed. `npm test` keeps
    # its build-then-run shape for humans, who have not already built.
    #
    # Lint runs in every shard on purpose. oxlint takes about a second on this
    # tree, and a shard that lints is a complete verdict on what it built
    # instead of a job whose meaning depends on a sibling.
    name: full gate (node 22, shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/3)
    needs: classify
    if: needs.classify.outputs.tier == 'full'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [1, 2, 3]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run build
      - run: node scripts/run-tests.mjs --shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/3
      - run: npm run lint

  full-floor:
    # The Node floor, proven where it decides something (APRV-149).
    # `engines.node` is >=20 and the floor is the version nobody develops on,
    # so it stays in the gate; what changed is when it runs. A pull_request run
    # is feedback for an author, and the merge-queue candidate is what stands
    # between a change and main, so the floor runs on the queue and on a push
    # to main. A pull request no longer waits for a second whole suite to
    # repeat what the shards above already said, and nothing becomes main
    # without the floor having run on it.
    #
    # Unsharded, and it compiles once as the shards do. One version running
    # once needs no matrix to coordinate, and the aggregator below reads its
    # single result. No lint step: oxlint's verdict does not vary by Node
    # major, and every shard above already has it.
    name: full gate (node 20 floor)
    needs: classify
    if: >-
      needs.classify.outputs.tier == 'full' &&
      (github.event_name == 'merge_group' ||
      (github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'))
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run build
      - run: node scripts/run-tests.mjs

  ci:
    # The one required check. `classify` alone passes regardless of tier
    # outcome, so branch protection requiring it would protect nothing; this
    # job succeeds only when the tier that was chosen actually ran and
    # succeeded. Skipped-when-required is a failure here, not a pass.
    #
    # `full` is the whole shard matrix: GitHub reports one result for a matrix
    # job and it is `success` only when every shard succeeded, so requiring
    # that result requires all three. The floor leg is conditional (APRV-149),
    # so this job decides which events owe a floor result rather than letting a
    # skipped job read as a pass on the events that must prove the floor.
    name: ci
    needs: [classify, doc-guard, records, full, full-floor]
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: aggregate tier outcomes
        env:
          TIER: ${{ needs.classify.outputs.tier }}
          CLASSIFY_RESULT: ${{ needs.classify.result }}
          DOC_RESULT: ${{ needs['doc-guard'].result }}
          RECORDS_RESULT: ${{ needs.records.result }}
          FULL_RESULT: ${{ needs.full.result }}
          FULL_FLOOR_RESULT: ${{ needs['full-floor'].result }}
          FLOOR_REQUIRED: ${{ github.event_name == 'merge_group' || (github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main') }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          echo "classify=$CLASSIFY_RESULT tier=$TIER doc-guard=$DOC_RESULT records=$RECORDS_RESULT full=$FULL_RESULT full-floor=$FULL_FLOOR_RESULT floor-required=$FLOOR_REQUIRED"
          if [ "$CLASSIFY_RESULT" != "success" ]; then
            echo "classify did not succeed; nothing downstream is trustworthy"
            exit 1
          fi
          case "$TIER" in
            light)
              [ "$DOC_RESULT" = "success" ] || { echo "light tier required doc-guard to succeed, got $DOC_RESULT"; exit 1; }
              ;;
            records)
              [ "$RECORDS_RESULT" = "success" ] || { echo "records tier required the records guards to succeed, got $RECORDS_RESULT"; exit 1; }
              ;;
            full)
              [ "$FULL_RESULT" = "success" ] || { echo "full tier required every shard of the full gate to succeed, got $FULL_RESULT"; exit 1; }
              if [ "$FLOOR_REQUIRED" = "true" ]; then
                [ "$FULL_FLOOR_RESULT" = "success" ] || { echo "this event must prove the Node 20 floor before anything becomes main, got $FULL_FLOOR_RESULT"; exit 1; }
              else
                [ "$FULL_FLOOR_RESULT" = "skipped" ] || [ "$FULL_FLOOR_RESULT" = "success" ] || { echo "the Node 20 floor leg neither was skipped nor succeeded on an event that does not require it, got $FULL_FLOOR_RESULT"; exit 1; }
              fi
              ;;
before:
full:
    name: full gate (node ${{ matrix.node-version }})
    needs: classify
    if: needs.classify.outputs.tier == 'full'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        node-version: [20, 22]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run build
      - run: npm test
      - run: npm run lint
      - run: npm run typecheck

  ci:
    # The one required check. `classify` alone passes regardless of tier
    # outcome, so branch protection requiring it would protect nothing; this
    # job succeeds only when the tier that was chosen actually ran and
    # succeeded. Skipped-when-required is a failure here, not a pass.
    name: ci
    needs: [classify, doc-guard, records, full]
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: aggregate tier outcomes
        env:
          TIER: ${{ needs.classify.outputs.tier }}
          CLASSIFY_RESULT: ${{ needs.classify.result }}
          DOC_RESULT: ${{ needs['doc-guard'].result }}
          RECORDS_RESULT: ${{ needs.records.result }}
          FULL_RESULT: ${{ needs.full.result }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          echo "classify=$CLASSIFY_RESULT tier=$TIER doc-guard=$DOC_RESULT records=$RECORDS_RESULT full=$FULL_RESULT"
          if [ "$CLASSIFY_RESULT" != "success" ]; then
            echo "classify did not succeed; nothing downstream is trustworthy"
            exit 1
          fi
          case "$TIER" in
            light)
              [ "$DOC_RESULT" = "success" ] || { echo "light tier required doc-guard to succeed, got $DOC_RESULT"; exit 1; }
              ;;
            records)
              [ "$RECORDS_RESULT" = "success" ] || { echo "records tier required the records guards to succeed, got $RECORDS_RESULT"; exit 1; }
              ;;
            full)
              [ "$FULL_RESULT" = "success" ] || { echo "full tier required the full gate to succeed, got $FULL_RESULT"; exit 1; }
              ;;
